title: Rust: rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet fails on main
description: Pre-existing failure confirmed at HEAD 978da4e (independent of b7z9.4.2 changes). survey_routing_headers (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs) NO_NEXT arm requires offset == packet length, but the test builds a plain nh=59 packet with an 8-byte payload and source-routes it via add_rpl_source_route; every advance_rpl_source_route relay step then surveys the RH3-followed-by-NO_NEXT-with-payload chain and returns InvalidSourceRoute. Decide: (a) tolerate NO_NEXT with trailing payload (accept, treat as opaque payload) or (b) change the test to use a real upper-layer next-header (e.g. UDP). Run: cargo test -p lichen-node --features std --lib rpl_stack::tests::rfc6554_route
